docs.title: AQUILO
docs.text: The Aquilo system provides the final API and data delivery layer for the Nexus pipeline, serving the processed and enriched data in a usable format.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Once all data processing and enrichment steps are complete, Aquilo exposes the final dataset through an API. This allows external organizations to access the high-quality JSON data produced by the pipeline.

docs.title: Key Functionalities
docs.text:
• Data API: Provides an interface for users and external systems to query processed data in JSON format.
  • Data Storage: Efficiently stores the final, high-quality dataset using ScyllaDB.
  • Service Delivery: Acts as the primary entry point for consumers of the Nexus data ecosystem.
